title: GreenSofa's Public Funding Record in Taiwan
dek: GreenSofa, also known as Greenpill Taiwan, keeps a public record of the rounds it has raised funds in, most recently 2,794 USDC in retro funding for public goods tooling.
excerpt: Since 2023, GreenSofa has documented its grants, donations and community funding experiments on one public page.
body:
GreenSofa, also known as Greenpill Taiwan, was founded on September 13, 2023. It aims to bring more people into the regenerative Web3 world, in line with the visions of Greenpill and Formosa Art Bank DAO (FAB DAO), a Taiwanese community that mints nonprofit NFTs and designs blockchain education for the public.

The chapter keeps a running record of its funding on HackMD. Recent entries include:

- March 2026: 2,794 USDC from Public Goods Tooling Development: Retro Funding, through Charmverse.
- December 2025: 2,000 DAI from the Public Goods Tooling Development Garden, through Gardens.
- August 2025: an Ethereum 10 Years Anniversary event, with 350 DAI in grants.
- April 2025: funding from two Gitcoin Grants 23 rounds, Hypercerts for Nature Stewards and Regen Coordination Global.
- February 2025: donations through Giveth's Loving on Public Goods campaign.

Earlier entries go back to the Gitcoin Grants 19 GreenPill Network round in November 2023, a donation to earthquake relief in Japan in January 2024, and the GreenPill x Octant Community Round in March 2024.

GreenSofa also maintains a Hypercerts dashboard that documents local public good contributions in Taiwan, and it has a project page on Giveth.
